evidence: In the 2D view C1's pads nearly abut U1's left pad row, C5 and C6 sit stacked with near-touching outlines, and the D1/R1/R2 cluster is packed so tightly that no clear assembly clearance is visible in the 3D top render.
Screw terminal J1 sits at the lower-left edge with wire openings facing outward, but pin headers J2 and J3 are inset inboard of the right edge rather than at a board edge with clear outward access.
Placement is ragged rather than gridded: C4 floats far above U2, C5/C6 are offset from each other, C3 sits diagonally off C1, and C2/J2/J3 sit at differing heights instead of aligned rows or columns.

In the 2D view the R1 and R2 designators stack on each other below D1, U1's designator is garbled by overlapping text inside its body, and the C5/C6 labels collide, making several references illegible.
The entire upper half of the board is dead space while all components crowd a congested bottom strip, and C4 is stranded well above the rest of the U2 group it serves.
